purpose: Development-only identification of a nonflat, useful local training actuator before new prospective evaluation
fixed_policy: Select strongest of five legal actions on original model selection panel; reuse same action for every adaptation candidate of that seed
candidate_selection: Maximize pooled development mean utility among candidates with nonnegative gain in each seed and clean development change >= -0.01 in each seed; deterministic listed-order tie break
future_field: seven dimensions: current hard value, adapt image BCE, adapt text CE, clean joint loss, effective operator displacement, momentum RMS, normalized learning time
new_holdout_access: Forbidden until sensitivity, ordinary, predictive and choice gates pass and final protocol plus controllers are frozen
holdout_plan: Keep original train10000/validation2000/evaluator10000 prefixes; expand only retention/test, use source suffixes beyond old retention1000/test2000; verify all pixel-identity exclusions. Target at least512 independent pairs per test/retention.
scope: Historical MNIST constructed text-image development. No LLM, general sufficiency/FBSDE theorem, new-writer, production-owner or universal retention claim.
failure_policy: Preserve every candidate and failed gate. No thresholds are changed after outcomes; any further development requires a separately recorded protocol and unused trajectory seeds. No current or V1 test/retention outcomes enter fitting.
